text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The decisive Arima Kinen. Agnes Tachyon, 
who had once stopped running, achieves a 
complete comeback and enters the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What pushed her to make a comeback was 
Manhattan Cafe's run and the light seen in 
the distance— namely, the world "beyond an 
Umamusume's limits."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Agnes Tachyon bared her fierce fighting 
spirit, claiming the world was hers, 
Manhattan Cafe saw the silhouette of her 
"friend" overlap with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Guiding each other, racing each other—the 
two headed toward the starting gates, each 
seeking their own ultimate horizon.
